---
title: "Resource ID Feature"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
tbl_pointer <- tbl(con, "read_parquet('CAISO_dam_big.parquet')")
```

```{r}
tbl_pointer |>
    colnames()
```

```{r}
data <- tbl_pointer |>
    filter(MARKETPRODUCTTYPE == "EN",
           RESOURCE_TYPE == "GENERATOR") |>
    select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA, SELFSCHEDMW) |>
    collect()
```

Get max MW
```{r}
observed_max <- data |>
    group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
    filter(!is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA)) |>
    slice_max(n=1, order_by = SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA)
```

Mean and median number of knots
```{r}
knots <- data |>
    group_by(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
    summarise(knots = n()) |>
    group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
    summarise(mean = mean(knots),
              median = median(knots))
```

single-point frequency

```{r}
num_bids <- data |>
    group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
    summarise(total_bids = n())

data |>
    group_by(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
    mutate(knots = n()) |>
    mutate(single (knots == 1))
```

NULL

```{r}
null <- data |>
    summarise(null = any((is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA)) & (is.na(SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA))))
```

% of self scheduled bids

```{r}
data |>
    mutate(self = !is.na(SELFSCHEDMW))
```
```{r}

filter MARKETPRODUCTTYPE = EN and resource_type
median #

what % of bids are single point bids

null - yes/no
```

```{r}
tbl_pointer |>
    select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA, SELFSCHEDMW) |>
```
